STATUS: ANSWER
Use bcftools norm with the -g (--gff-annot) option and a GFF file. When a GFF file is given, bcftools follows the HGVS 3' rule and right-aligns variants in transcripts on the forward strand [bcftools_manual#h092]. For overlapping transcripts, the default is to left-align the variant [bcftools_manual#h092]. The GFF3 format details are referenced to the bcftools csq section, which is not included in the provided sources [bcftools_manual#h092].
